orphan_works: No specific orphan works regime (IFLA 2012 report: Ghana relies on international guidance); s.14 sets term for anonymous works
digital_protection: s.42(1)(h)-(i) offences: circumventing TPMs and trafficking in circumvention devices/services; s.42 also covers removal/alteration of rights management information
fair_use_exceptions: Closed list of permitted uses (ss. 19-21: personal & teaching use, program backup, libraries)
enforcement_body: Copyright Office (Copyright Department, Ministry of Justice)
